question: ‘In The Afternoon of Time: An Autobiography’ was written by which of the following Indian poets of the 20th century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harivansh Rai Bachchan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Harivansh Rai Bachchan**

__
 
• Indian poet and writer of the **Nayi Kavita literary movement **of early 20th century Hindi literature.
 
• He was also a poet of the **Hindi Kavi Sammelan**.
 
• He is best known for his early work **Madhushala.**
 
• In 1976, he received the **Padma Bhushan** for his service to Hindi literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Kuvempu**

 
• **Kuppali Venkatappa Puttappa** was an Indian poet, playwright, novelist and critic.
 
• He is widely regarded as the** greatest Kannada poet of the 20th century. **
 
• He was the** first Kannada writer to receive the Jnanpith Award**.

**Rahat Indori**

 
• **Indian Bollywood lyricist and Urdu poet**.
 
• He was also a **former professor of Urdu language and a painter**.
 
• He was a **pedagogist of Urdu literature at DAVV.**

**Sahir Ludhiyanvi**

 
• **Indian poet and film song lyricist who wrote primarily in Urdu in addition to Hindi**.
 
• His work** influenced Indian cinema, in particular Bollywood films.**
 
• He won a **Filmfare Award for Best Lyricist for Taj Mahal.**
